title: Fail-closed pre-push review with a round budget
summary: The pre-push review stops being advisory. `--warn-only` is removed, so `osf review run` now exits non-zero on a kept must-fix or should-fix finding and on a review that could not run. To keep a broken reviewer from blocking a push forever, a new round budget in `review_run` counts failed rounds per worktree in the journal state directory and lets the push through once the limit is passed; a pass clears the counts, and a could-not-run streak ends blocked with a message instead of silently retrying. A credential preflight in `reviewers` decides a missing key or login file before any worker starts, the work item can now come from `OSF_WORK_ITEM`, secret scrubbing also reads agent login files, and untracked `.osf/` output no longer counts as part of the change.

nodes.label: moon `review` task
nodes.subtitle: osf review run --if-enabled --work-item …
nodes.summary: The pre-push task. It drops `--warn-only`, passes `--work-item .osf/out/work-item.txt`, and its exit code now gates the push.

nodes.label: review-check workflow
nodes.subtitle: base-branch CI
nodes.summary: The merge authority. It runs `osf review run` per reviewer and `osf review reduce` in the final job; unchanged here, but it shares the exit-code rule.

nodes.label: review run / reduce
nodes.subtitle: review_run_exit_code, review_reduce_exit_code
nodes.summary: `--warn-only` is gone from both argument structs, and the commands return the computed code directly.

nodes.label: finish_review
nodes.subtitle: verdict + kept findings → exit code
nodes.summary: Computes the base code from the reducer verdict, promotes a Pass to 1 when a kept must-fix or should-fix finding exists, and — for `review run` only — applies the round budget before returning.

nodes.label: ReviewConfig
nodes.subtitle: in_sandbox_rounds, could_not_run_rounds
nodes.summary: Two new positive-integer settings, both defaulting to 3 and both refused at zero or with a wrong type. The default whole-run timeout drops from 2700 to 1800 seconds.

nodes.label: review_run::run
nodes.subtitle: setup, run_reviewer, reduce
nodes.summary: Orchestrates lens selection, reviewer runs and reduction into a RunOutcome carrying the verdict and kept findings.

nodes.label: round_allows_push
nodes.subtitle: RoundCounts, RoundKind
nodes.summary: Applies the pre-push budget: a pass clears the counts, a findings round increments and allows the push once past the limit, a could-not-run round increments and returns an error naming the limit once past it.

nodes.label: missing_credentials
nodes.subtitle: Reviewer::missing_credentials
nodes.summary: Decides before any worker starts whether a reviewer has no way to sign in: no non-empty credential variable and no existing login path. Templated reviewers are exempt.

nodes.label: preflight_and_not_run
nodes.subtitle: preflight_reviewer_run
nodes.summary: Turns a preflight failure into a reviewer run whose every lens is recorded could-not-run with the same reason, so no process starts and no timeout is waited out.

nodes.label: read_work_item
nodes.subtitle: --work-item, then OSF_WORK_ITEM
nodes.summary: Falls back to the `OSF_WORK_ITEM` environment variable when no path is given or the path cannot be read, so the pre-push hook need not write a file.

nodes.label: secret_values::held
nodes.subtitle: login_values, json_leaves
nodes.summary: Also collects every string leaf of the agents' JSON login files, so a provider key kept in an auth file is scrubbed from transcripts like an environment token.

nodes.label: changeset_risk::changed_files
nodes.subtitle: untracked .osf/ filtered
nodes.summary: Untracked paths under `.osf/` are excluded from the change, so osf's own review output cannot raise the risk tier or change lens selection between rounds.

nodes.label: journal state dir
nodes.subtitle: review-rounds/<hash>.json
nodes.summary: The state directory outside the worktree. Round counts are keyed by a hash of the canonical worktree path, so each develop run has its own count and the builder cannot edit it.

edges.label: no --warn-only
edges.summary: The pre-push task now invokes the review without the flag that forced exit 0, so its exit code reaches the push.

edges.label: per reviewer
edges.summary: The CI workflow runs the same command; it now inherits the should-fix rule at the final reduce step.
`review run` passes count_rounds true; `review reduce` passes false, so only the push spends the budget.

edges.label: round limits
edges.summary: The exit code reads the two round limits from the repository's `[review]` section.
The new step between the verdict and the exit code: the budget decides whether a failing round stops the push or lets it through.

edges.label: load / save / clear
edges.summary: Counts are read, incremented and cleared in the journal state, never in the worktree.
A reviewer with no credential is recorded could-not-run before a worker starts.
The preflight asks the reviewer whether any credential variable or login path is present.
Context building reads the work item, now with an environment fallback.
Transcripts are scrubbed with the wider secret set, which now includes login-file values.
Setup assesses the change; untracked `.osf/` output no longer counts toward it.

views.title: The pre-push review gate
views.summary: How a review outcome becomes a push decision: the moon task calls the CLI, the CLI applies the verdict and the round budget, and the budget reads and writes the journal state.
